purpose.decisionBasis: Two new meetings automaticGSS403→361 edits, true activity still237 and one meeting regression. Repeating binary activity/GSS or monoPS4 alone is excluded. New controlled variable is speaker-conditioned spectral masks driving original dual-channel beamforming, with matched neural-mono and strongest cached control.

protocol.separation: Unmodified complete author build_model/extract_speaker, exact matching state tensors, strict load, FP32/eval, matching embedded ECAPA encoder. Both mixture/enrollment separately peak-normalized as official CLI. Every predicted active person with automatically chosen same-meeting solo anchor is extracted. No reference/name/count or output-track deletion.
protocol.asr: Same pinned native1.7B/BF16/eager/greedy512/Chinese/no-context and bounded raw-preserving recovery. Every extracted lane is transcribed; exact-zero pipeline guard only. Source mixture full-ASR cache retained, not re-recognized.
protocol.scoring: Replace only selected original30s root text in the existing complete per-person Document, leave all other full-meeting text unchanged, then score against the entire original reference. All duplicate/missing/incorrect lanes count. Report global cpCER and independently fixed full-speaker DER mapping/unknown-unmatched diagnostic; no per-clip oracle mapping or boundary-word discard. Categories use full reference utterances, not a claimed pure overlap-word score.
protocol.retainRule: Require fewer whole-L fixed-mapping/unknown-unmatched content edits than the frozen baseline, no worse full-S ordinary control edits, and no new complete-execution failure. Otherwise retain raw outputs and reject scaling this exact candidate; no threshold/window/enrollment sweep. Improvements are development component evidence, never full<5%, final holdout or sale acceptance.
protocol.singleSpeakerProtection: Ordinary production route retains source recording; forced extraction is an explicit damage control, not silently applied by default.
protocol.preparationFailure: Original model attempt stopped on missing torchaudio before weights or any inference. Pinned unmodified official Python frontend added only to separation-worker path; standard PCM wave I/O and native Torch are unchanged. No model/audio/retention/scoring setting changed.
protocol.fullRoute: Every predicted-overlap root, all predicted-active enrolled people, same native encoder top1 self-identity check against all6 frozen automatic anchors. All rejected raw lanes retained; no hard time-activity masking. If no lane admitted in a root, retain its full original transcript. Other roots retain original whole output. Same thresholds/model/ASR as routed component, no per-root winner selection.
protocol.fullRetentionRule: Report full-L fixed global DER mapping/unknown-unmatched and standard cpCER, all-person errors, short utterance and overlap-context categories separately. Any total regression rejects this whole candidate, no per-root model cherry-picking. Ordinary source route stays byte-identical. Short-person regression and absent/unregistered speakers remain explicit even if total improves; no formal5% or sale pass from this one development meeting.
protocol.algorithm: Unmodified matching FP32/eval PS4 cue model on original mic0. Non-overlapping <=30s context chunks, separately author peak-normalized and output restored to original mic amplitude. Neural time-frequency target ratio |S|²/(|S|²+|Y0-S|²+eps), clipped to[0,1], drives pinned MVDR-Souden/BAN on ORIGINAL paired0/1 STFT1024Blackman/256/fade, reference0. No GSS EM, activity gate, neural output admission or word filtering. All known people counted. Ordinary bypass original mic0 on both arms.
protocol.activity: Existing full nativeFP16 diarization only. The identical predicted lexical-segment sample mask is applied to every overlap arm, including the mono baseline, after spatial processing. This is a bounded segmentation-controlled research screen, not a new production hard-gating policy; all missed words outside the prediction are charged. No reference/oracle activities or words enter processing.
protocol.ordinary: First predicted single-ID >=25s root in each new meeting; ordinary rawdual bypass is byte-identical to mono. No alternative ordinary window if reference audit contradicts the prediction.
protocol.recognition: Exact prior native1.7B inference AST, same512tokens/BF16/greedy/Chinese/no-context/bounded recovery. All raw generations retained; no filler, duplication or reference-word filtering.
protocol.primaryComparison: Raw paired0/1 fixedGSS versus original0 with identical predicted activity gates. No oracle count/turn/text/slot choice, no parameter or codec sweep. Full per-mic DER and short-span recall reported separately; mic0 always guides separation regardless of reference score.
protocol.retention: To expand to remaining roots: beat cached automaticGSS total216 edits and each root30/186; reduce the lost S002-F deletion count; do not worsen another participant deletions; both ordinary controls remain original PCM/text. Otherwise stop this candidate, keep all absent-person insertions and do not sweep masks/thresholds/models.
protocol.scope: Local pipeline feasibility, not fullCER<5%, pure-overlapCER, current-card dual-mic performance, Android deployment or sale qualification.
protocol.conditionsMeaning: Matched neural_mono vs neural_spatial isolates the spatial filter; both also compared with cached strongest automaticGSS baseline on identical roots. This is NOT a newly trained joint model or a claim the mono backbone accepts2channels.

review.metric: Fixed full-meeting-identity-mapped character edit counts on prediction-selected30s windows; whole midpoint-selected reference utterances, straddling boundaries disclosed. Not strict full-meetingCER or pure-overlapCER.

decision.owner: 好的, 你看看模型那些要怎么继续推进到可用版本, 卡太久了；有一直在原地踏步嘛
decision.actualModelOutcome: No usable model delivered. One frozen speaker-conditioned mask+originaldualMVDR candidate actually executed, failed the predeclared gate and stopped without sweeps or expansion. Old product defaults and strongest research baseline retained.

previouslyMissingSpeaker.interpretation: Finding some target words while adding133other/unsupported words is not successful recovery.

decision.reasonForStopping: The cue model already adds unwanted text; the static dual spatial output greatly increases insertions. Correct identity and target absence are not solved by connecting this unadapted mono cue model to a fixed spatial filter. Insertions may include cross-talk and ASR hallucination; this does not attribute every extra character to a specific acoustic source.
excludedNextActions: No additional mask/threshold/postfilter sweep on these clips.
No per-person best-track choice, insertion deletion or filler cleaning to improve measured scores.
No repeat of the old4s fixed-feature activity-head microtraining as a full target-separation model.

newActualPreparation.readiness: Ready as bounded text-supervised TSE training/gradient input pilot. Not enough for a general production model; expand real training sessions/rooms and define actual waveform or differentiable ASR-proxy supervision before a substantive training run. Do not repeat the old4s-frame-head microtraining or treat a train-loss drop as acceptance.

trainingDataCaveats: Three TRAIN-source meetings only:still a pilot, not a general corpus.
Text labels fit complete target utterances within each waveform; original two channels and disjoint same-person profile retained.
Real-overlap target clean waveforms are not present. Differentiable ASR-proxy or verified source-target supervision must be implemented before substantive training.
No physical-speaker-independent split established; validation meeting separation alone does not prove it.

stageTimeCorrection.reason: New stage names are cue/spatial; inherited scorer looked for oldseparation name and showed0. Only timing aggregation corrected, no score/output changed.

decision.next: 继续原模型任务，转入真实目标声音提取的训练实现：先扩充真实训练会议/声学条件，并用已准备的完整发言＋独立样音＋目标缺席样本，建立可微ASR文字监督或经过核验的目标波形监督；保留强基线和独立验证。先证明训练目标与梯度正确、目标缺席能拒绝别人的话且普通目标不被删，再进行一轮固定训练和整会逐人评分。当前214对仅输入试点，不能拿小样本训练损失、运行成功或资料数量冒充可用模型；不继续拼装纯后处理。原<5%、纪要事实、双端实卡和售卖均未达标。
